title: Intercept article on Grusch's 2018 hospitalization

tellings.quote: was an article written a few weeks after the hearing by The Intercept. The article describes Dave's hospitalization back in 2018,
they basically leaked his medical records from the I guess the the uh police department locally in Virginia.
tellings.difference: Frames it as a leak of medical records by a local Virginia police department and does not name The Intercept.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Grusch's records being made public after the hearing, records that describe his medical history; this telling says they came from local Virginia police.

plain: A few weeks after David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, testified to Congress in 2023 about secret UFO programmes, the news site The Intercept published an article describing his hospitalization in 2018. Michels tells this himself, and in a later episode he describes it as a leak of Grusch's medical records from a local police department in Virginia, without naming The Intercept. He raises it because the article bore on how the public would judge Grusch's testimony.
